manual_review.three_failures: Invented location answers under unseen wording; no score exclusions or post hoc threshold changes.
manual_review.broader_failures: Missing location relation words, token fragments for times/days/names, failed missing-fact abstention and clarification.

next_scope: Answer length/tokenization diversity, multi-word facts, distractors and clarification/unknown responses, with retained skill checks and fresh frozen holdouts. No additional updates authorized by this experiment plan.
limitations: Primary-authored correlated synthetic tests; not an independent benchmark
Initial color turns repeat in correction conversations
All test values individually seen in training; held-out combinations and wording only
Explicit corrections can be solved by copying the last user message; persistent memory untested
Broader bank already exposed and secondary check is post-selection descriptive evidence
Learning rate, data and exposure schedule changed; no single-factor causal attribution
